question: Which city of India will host the 2023 International Olympic Committee Session?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is hosting an IOC session after **40 **years, with the last one held in** New Delhi** in **1983**.
 
• The session will be hosted at the **Jio World Centre**.
 
• The previous session of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) was held in **Beijing, China**, from January 18 to 22, 2022.
 
• The most recent International Olympic Committee (IOC) session was held in **Paris**, where **eight **new IOC members were elected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The IOC was founded in **1894** b**y Pierre de Coubertin** to revive the Olympic Games.
 
• The IOC is headquartered in **Lausanne**, **Switzerland**.
 
• The IOC operates under the **Olympic Charter**, which outlines the rules for the organization and conduct of the Olympic Games.
 
• The IOC consists of 100+ members, including athletes, officials, and representatives from National Olympic Committees (NOCs).
 
• The IOC is responsible for selecting the host cities for the Olympic Games, with the next Summer Games set for **2028** in **Los** **Angeles**.
